subtask: REQ-086 scene-derived photography / lighting / CMF acting-Prompt consumption

requirements.summary: Scene-derived photography decisions must survive from per-asset Art Direction into the acting Prompt plane.
requirements.upstream_authority: asset.asset_art_direction camera_or_view / focal_length_mm / camera_position / focus_dof / lighting / cmf

requirements.summary: Concrete pixel-changing photography parameters selected upstream must be consumed by the final acting Prompt and auditable by value, not inferred from section presence.
Scene-derived camera, lighting and CMF remain per-object authority and reach the final acting model Prompt without stale Strategy/runtime override.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 41386473797: focused 3 passed; Phase 4 adjacent 18 passed; complete v067 cross-scope 334 passed
verified_behavior: Agent-authored camera fields override stale Strategy/runtime photography fields while non-authored fields may remain compatible fill-ins.
Agent-authored lighting fields override stale Strategy/runtime fields and carry AGENT_ASSET_ART_DIRECTION provenance plus authored_fields.
Agent-authored CMF fields override stale Strategy/runtime fields and carry AGENT_ASSET_ART_DIRECTION provenance plus authored_fields.
The final model-native Prompt contains the authored camera, lighting and CMF leaf values; stale global Strategy tokens are absent in the focused proof.
Final prompt_consumption_audit emits scene_derived_camera, scene_derived_lighting and scene_derived_cmf checks that verify the exact authored subset by value.
requirements.residual_risk: Targeted code/Prompt-consumption proof is complete. Fresh K01 FULL materialization, Provider Result, actual pixels/frames and installed-plugin readback remain Phase 10/11 E2E evidence and are not claimed here.

cross_scope_verification.baseline_repair_note: Before the final REQ-086 run, two unrelated previously-verified Phase 2 regressions discovered by broad verification were restored on main and then the entire v067 set was rerun green with REQ-086 applied.

invariants: Per-asset Art Direction is the authority for fields it explicitly authored; stale Strategy/runtime defaults cannot override those fields.
Runtime may preserve compatible fill-ins only for fields not authored by the Agent.
Prompt-consumption PASS requires concrete authored values to exist in the final acting Prompt; section headings alone are insufficient.
No Provider/actual-output or Fresh K01 FULL closure is inferred from targeted Prompt tests.
